description: This Swift source file defines an enumeration 'NetworkInterfaceIPv4' that provides functionality to list IPv4 network interfaces on the system. It includes a nested struct 'AddressEntry' representing interface name and IP address, and a static method 'addresses()' that retrieves all active IPv4 network interfaces excluding loopback interfaces.

methods.name: addresses
methods.description: Returns an array of 'AddressEntry' structs representing active IPv4 network interfaces on the system.
